profile.name: EmStat Pico微型恒电位仪模块
profile.description: 这是一款小型电化学测量模块，用于控制电极电位并采集电化学响应，可通过MethodSCRIPT执行测试流程。它常用于实验室电化学实验、传感器开发以及便携式分析仪器集成。
profile.description_en: This is a compact electrochemical measurement module used to control electrode potential and acquire electrochemical responses, with test procedures executed through MethodSCRIPT. It is commonly used for laboratory electrochemistry, sensor development, and integration into portable analyzers.
